summary: Well-structured test suite with good organization and coverage of main functionality (secret classification, report grouping, output formats, CLI behavior, error handling). Clear fixtures and deterministic dates enable reliable testing. However, rigor is limited by missing boundary condition tests (e.g., secret expiring exactly on warning threshold, on today, one day ago), edge cases (empty config, secrets without optional 'required_by' field, invalid dates, negative rotation_days), and insufficient variety in test data. Tests cover happy path and basic errors effectively, but would miss unusual inputs and corner cases. Parametrized tests could reduce duplication. Suite would catch most regressions but not all possible failures.
